text: Extremely Disappointing Experience with Nykaa Fashion I ordered a product from Nykaa Fashion on 5th August, which was supposed to be delivered on 10th August. The delivery kept getting delayed, and multiple times I received “out for delivery” updates, but I never received a call or message from the delivery person. Later, the status would suddenly say that I was unavailable at home, which was completely untrue. I was home and available the entire time. I even tried contacting the delivery person, but he never responded and eventually blocked my number. I also tried contacting Nykaa Fashion customer care several times. Initially, my calls were answered, but later the calls kept getting disconnected, and I couldn’t get any proper assistance. Now I’ve received an update saying that my order is being returned to the warehouse because of three failed delivery attempts, despite the fact that I was available and was never properly contacted. Please guys, don’t shop from Nykaa Fashion. I personally will never shop from them again. And don’t fall for their offers—especially if you order an item on offer, because based on my experience, they’ll make sure it never gets delivered. Pathetic delivery service, pathetic customer support, and absolutely no accountability. Extremely disappointing experience!

text: Very Disappointed This is honestly one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve had with Nykaa Fashion. I had placed two orders. I’ve been trying to reach Nykaa Fashion customer care continuously for the past 3–4 days. Calls either don’t get answered or simply get disconnected. I even contacted Nykaa Beauty customer care, and they answered immediately, but they said they had no option to transfer my call to Nykaa Fashion. Then what exactly is the point of having customer support if customers cannot even reach the support team when there is an issue? For a brand as big as Nykaa, this level of service is honestly unacceptable. Extremely frustrating, disappointing and completely unresponsive.
